meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把某一天的日历事件和未完成任务整理成摘要：日程按时间列出事件与状态，待办按截止时间列出，并在小结给出冲突提醒与空闲时段。
howto.when: 当你说“今天有什么安排”“明天有什么会”“这周还有哪些安排”等，涉及某天或本周的日程与待办摘要时，技能会触发。

say.note: 返回今日日程与未完成待办摘要。

say.text: 明天的日程和未完成任务有哪些？
say.note: 返回明天的日程与待办摘要。
返回本周范围内的日程与待办摘要。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude takes a given day's calendar events and incomplete tasks and turns them into a summary: events listed by time with status, to-dos by due date, plus conflict reminders and free slots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions like "What's today?", "What meetings do I have tomorrow?", or "What's left this week?" asking for a date-based schedule and task summary.

say_en.note: Returns today's summary of events and incomplete tasks.

say_en.text: What's on my calendar tomorrow, and what tasks are still open?
say_en.note: Returns tomorrow's schedule and task summary.

say_en.text: What else is planned this week?
say_en.note: Returns this week's schedule and task summary.
